candidates.change_summary: Replace the selfdestruct target to smartfix_owner so the contract is sent to the saved owner rather than msg.sender.
Remove the require check so anyone can call sudicideAnyone and trigger selfdestruct to msg.sender.
Insert a revert after the require to prevent selfdestruct from ever executing even when require passes.
Change the require condition to allow anyone except the owner to call sudicideAnyone, flipping the access check.
